description: Using Oracle SQL Developer (already connected to the HR schema), create a new table called TRAINING_COURSES to track employee training programs. The table should have these columns: COURSE_ID (NUMBER, primary key), COURSE_NAME (VARCHAR2(100), NOT NULL), INSTRUCTOR (VARCHAR2(50)), DURATION_HOURS (NUMBER), DEPARTMENT_ID (NUMBER, foreign key referencing the DEPARTMENTS table), and START_DATE (DATE). After creating the table, insert at least 3 training course records with realistic data referencing actual department IDs from the HR schema.
